thread:
Maya (marketing): Need a 1-page pocket brief for enterprise launch — focus: security, SLA bullets, deploy-mode matrix. Draft by EOD Friday?

Raj (growth): Target: CISO & platform teams. Keep hook 1-2 sentences + 3 value bullets.

Lina (product): SLA wording proposal: Dedicated: 99.95% (commit tier). Hosted: best-effort with standard fallbacks. Private: negotiable infra SLAs. Add note about automated model-variant fallback.

Omar (field): Two CTAs: Request secure pilot (VPC/on-prem) -> route to AE@enterprise (2hr SLA). Get cost/latency estimate -> Growth queue, automated calc. Use HubSpot tag: enterprise_brief_request.

Jules (designer): Ill mock a compact layout: headline, 3 icons, tiny deploy-mode table. ETA 18 hours.

Ken (eng): Benchmarks to include as "observed medians": p50 gen latency ~60ms/token (4k context) on Dedicated T4-like pool; throughput ~2k tokens/sec per GPU; prefix caching reduces token cost ~20-35%. Small-print caveat.

Maya (marketing): Good. Action items: Maya copy draft, Jules design, Lina SLA sign-off, Raj HubSpot form.

deploy-bot: draft pushed to /assets/marketing/pocket-briefs/2420001111-draft-v1.pdf (auto).
notes: Routing: Secure pilot -> AE@enterprise + #sales-enterprise ping; Estimate -> Growth webhook; HubSpot tag enterprise_brief_request
